40020426.author: पदार्थः
40020426.content: ततः then, तान् them, लक्ष्य having seen, वित्रस्तान् terrified, यक्षेन्द्रान् the chief Yakshas, च and, सहस्रशः by thousands, धनाध्यक्षः the lord of wealth, महायक्षम् to the great Yaksha, माणिचारम् Manichara, अथ then, अब्रवीत् spoke.

40020426.author: Translation
40020426.content: Then, the lord of wealth, having seen those thousands of terrified chief Yakshas, spoke to the great Yaksha Manichara.

40020427.author: पदार्थः
40020427.content: रावणम् Ravana, जहि kill, यक्षेन्द्र O chief of Yakshas, दुर्वृत्तम् ill-behaved, पापचेतसम् evil-minded, शरणम् refuge, भव be, वीराणाम् for the brave ones, यक्षाणाम् for the Yakshas, युद्धशालिनाम् who are skilled in battle.

40020427.author: Translation
40020427.content: O chief of Yakshas, kill the ill-behaved and evil-minded Ravana, and be a refuge for these brave Yakshas skilled in battle.

40020428.author: पदार्थः
40020428.content: एवम् thus, उक्तः addressed, महाबाहुः the mighty-armed, माणिभद्रः Manibhadra, सुदुर्जयः very difficult to conquer, वृतः surrounded, यक्षसहस्रैः by thousands of Yakshas, तु indeed, चतुर्भिः by four (thousands), समयोधयत् he fought.

40020428.author: Translation
40020428.content: Thus addressed, the mighty-armed Manibhadra, who was very difficult to conquer, surrounded by four thousand Yakshas, then engaged in battle.

40020429.author: पदार्थः
40020429.content: ते they, गदामुसलप्रासैः with maces, pestles, and spears, शक्तितोमरमुद्गरैः with lances, javelins, and hammers, अभिघ्नन्तः striking, तदा then, यक्षाः the Yakshas, राक्षसान् towards the Rakshasas, समुपाद्रवन् rushed

40020429.author: Translation
40020429.content: Then, the Yakshas, striking with maces, pestles, spears, lances, javelins, and hammers, rushed towards the Rakshasas.

40020430.author: पदार्थः
40020430.content: कुर्वन्तः doing, तुमुलम् tumultuous, युद्धम् battle, चरन्तः moving, श्येनवत् like a hawk, लघु swiftly, बाढम् fiercely, प्रयच्छन् giving (blows), न not, इच्छामि I wish (to stop), दीयताम् let it be given (the fight), इति thus, भाषिणः speaking

40020430.author: Translation
40020430.content: They engaged in a tumultuous battle, moving swiftly like hawks, giving fierce blows and speaking as if to say, "I do not wish to stop, let the fight be given!"

40020431.author: पदार्थः
40020431.content: ततः then, देवाः the gods, सगन्धर्वाः with Gandharvas, ऋषयः the sages, ब्रह्मवादिनः who expound the Vedas, दृष्ट्वा having seen, तत् that, तुमुलम् tumultuous, युद्धम् battle, परम् great, विस्मयम् wonder, आगमन् attained

40020431.author: Translation
40020431.content: Then, the gods along with the Gandharvas, and the sages who expound the Vedas, having witnessed that tumultuous battle, were filled with great wonder.

40020432.author: पदार्थः
40020432.content: यक्षाणाम् of the Yakshas, तु indeed, प्रहस्तेन by Prahasta, सहस्रम् a thousand, निहतम् slain, रणे in battle, महोदरेण by Mahodara, च and, अनिन्द्यम् blameless (warriors), सहस्रम् a thousand, अपरम् another, हतम् slain

40020432.author: Translation
40020432.content: Indeed, a thousand Yakshas were slain in battle by Prahasta, and another thousand blameless (excellent) Yaksha warriors were slain by Mahodara.

40020433.author: पदार्थः
40020433.content: क्रुद्धेन by the enraged, च and, तदा then, राजन् O King, मारीचेन by Maricha, युयुत्सुना who desired to fight, निमेषान्तरमात्रेण in merely the twinkling of an eye, द्वे सहस्रे two thousand, निपातिते struck down

40020433.author: Translation
40020433.content: And then, O King, by the enraged Maricha, who desired to fight, two thousand (Yakshas) were struck down in merely the twinkling of an eye.

40020434.author: पदार्थः
40020434.content: क्व च where also, यक्षार्जवं the straightforwardness of the Yakshas, युद्धं battle, क्व च where also, मायाबलाश्रयम् reliance on illusory power, रक्षसां of the Rakshasas, पुरुषव्याघ्र O tiger among men, तेन by that, ते they, अभ्यधिका superior, युधि in battle.

40020434.author: Translation
40020434.content: O tiger among men, how can the straightforward battle of the Yakshas compare with the Rakshasas' reliance on magical power, which is why the Rakshasas are superior in war.

40020435.author: पदार्थः
40020435.content: धूम्राक्षेण by Dhūmrākṣa, समागम्य having met, माणिभद्रो Maṇibhadra, महारणे in the great battle, मुसलेन with a mace, उरसि on the chest, क्रोधात् with anger, ताडितो struck, न च and not, कम्पितः trembled.

40020435.author: Translation
40020435.content: In the great battle, Maṇibhadra, having encountered Dhūmrākṣa, was struck on the chest with a mace by him in anger, yet he did not even tremble.

40020436.author: पदार्थः
40020436.content: ततो then, गदां a mace, समाविध्य having brandished, माणिभद्रेण by Maṇibhadra, राक्षसः the Rakshasa, धूम्राक्षः Dhūmrākṣa, ताडितो struck, मूर्ध्नि on the head, विह्वलः bewildered, स he, पपात ह indeed fell.

40020436.author: Translation
40020436.content: Then, Maṇibhadra, having brandished his mace, struck the Rakshasa Dhūmrākṣa on the head, and he, bewildered, indeed fell.

40020437.author: पदार्थः
40020437.content: धूम्राक्षं Dhūmrākṣa, ताडितं struck, दृष्ट्वा having seen, पतितं fallen, शोणितोक्षितम् drenched in blood, अभ्यधावत rushed towards, सङ्ग्रामे in battle, माणिभद्रं Maṇibhadra, दशाननः Daśānana.

40020437.author: Translation
40020437.content: Having seen Dhūmrākṣa struck, fallen, and drenched in blood, Daśānana rushed towards Maṇibhadra in battle.

40020438.author: पदार्थः
40020438.content: तं him, क्रुद्धम् angry, अभिधावन्तं rushing towards, माणिभद्रो Maṇibhadra, दशाननम् Daśānana, शक्तिभिः with spears, ताडयामास struck, तिसृभिः with three, यक्षपुङ्गवः the foremost among Yakshas.

40020438.author: Translation
40020438.content: The foremost among Yakshas, Maṇibhadra, struck that angry Daśānana, who was rushing towards him, with three spears.

40020439.author: पदार्थः
40020439.content: ताडितो being struck, माणिभद्रस्य of Manibhadra, मुकुटे on the crown, प्राहरत् he struck, रणे in battle, तस्य his, तेन by that, प्रहारेण by the blow, मुकुटं the crown, पार्श्वम् to the side, आगतम् came.

40020439.author: Translation
40020439.content: Being struck, he then struck Manibhadra's crown in battle, and by that blow, his crown was knocked to the side.

40020440.author: पदार्थः
40020440.content: ततः then, संयुध्यमानेन by one who was fighting, विष्टब्धो firm, न not, व्यकम्पत he trembled, तदाप्रभृति from that time onwards, यक्षो the Yaksha, असौ that, पार्श्वमौलिः one with a side-tilted crown, इति thus, स्मृतः is known, सन्नादः a great roar, सुमहान् very great, राजन् O King, तस्मिन् on that, शैले mountain, अभ्यवर्तत resounded.

40020440.author: Translation
40020440.content: Then, though fighting, he remained firm and did not tremble, and from that time onwards, that Yaksha became known as Pārśvamauli (one with a side-tilted crown); O King, a very great roar resounded on that mountain.

40020441.author: पदार्थः
40020441.content: ततः then, दूरात् from afar, प्रददृशे was seen, धनाध्यक्षो the lord of wealth, गदाधरः the mace-wielder, शुक्रप्रौष्ठपदाभ्यां by Shukra and Praushthapada, च and, पद्मशङ्खसमावृतः surrounded by Padma and Shankha.

40020441.author: Translation
40020441.content: Then, from afar, the mace-wielding lord of wealth (Kubera) was seen, accompanied by Shukra and Praushthapada, and surrounded by Padma and Shankha.

40020442.author: पदार्थः
40020442.content: सः he, दृष्ट्वा having seen, भ्रातरं his brother, सङ्ख्ये in battle, शापात् due to a curse, विभ्रष्टगौरवम् whose glory was lost, उवाच spoke, वचनं words, धीमान् the wise one, युक्तं appropriate, पैतामहे in the paternal, कुले family.

40020442.author: Translation
40020442.content: Having seen his brother in battle, whose glory was lost due to a curse, the wise Kubera spoke words appropriate for their paternal lineage.

40020443.author: पदार्थः
40020443.content: यत् because, मया by me, वार्यमाणः being restrained, त्वं you, न not, अवगच्छसि understand, दुर्मते O evil-minded one, पश्चात् afterwards, अस्य of this, फलं the fruit, प्राप्य having obtained, ज्ञास्यसे you will know, निरयं to hell, गतः having gone.

40020443.author: Translation
40020443.content: O evil-minded one, because you do not understand even when restrained by me, you will realize the consequence of this after having gone to hell.

40020444.author: पदार्थः
40020444.content: यः who, हि indeed, मोहात् from delusion, विषम् poison, पीत्वा having drunk, न not, अवगच्छति understands, दुर्मतिः the evil-minded one, सः he, तस्य its, परिणामान्ते at the end of the consequence, जानीते knows, कर्मणः of the action, फलम् the fruit.

40020444.author: Translation
40020444.content: An evil-minded person who, out of delusion, drinks poison and does not understand its nature, will only realize the consequence of that action at its ultimate fruition.

40020445.author: पदार्थः
40020445.content: देवताः gods, न not, अभिनन्दन्ति approve, धर्मयुक्तेन by one endowed with righteousness, केनचित् by anyone, येन by which, त्वम् you, ईदृशम् such, भावम् state, नीतः सन् having been brought, न not, अवबुद्ध्यसे understand.

40020445.author: Translation
40020445.content: The gods do not approve of such a state, nor does any righteous person, by which you have been brought to this condition and yet do not understand it.

40020446.author: पदार्थः
40020446.content: मातरम् mother, पितरम् father, यः who, हि indeed, आचार्यम् teacher, च and, अवमन्यते disrespects, सः he, पश्यति sees, फलम् the fruit, तस्य of that, प्रेतराजवशम् under the sway of the king of the dead, गतः having gone.

40020446.author: Translation
40020446.content: Indeed, whoever disrespects their mother, father, and teacher will see the consequences of such actions after falling under the dominion of Yama, the king of the dead.

40020447.author: पदार्थः
40020447.content: अध्रुवे in the impermanent, हि indeed, शरीरे body, यः who, न not, करोति does, तपः अर्जनम् acquisition of penance, सः he, पश्चात् afterwards, तप्यते repents, मूढः the foolish one, मृतः having died, दृष्ट्वा having seen, आत्मनः of oneself, गतिम् the destination.

40020447.author: Translation
40020447.content: Indeed, the foolish person who does not accumulate merit through penance in this impermanent body will repent later, after death, upon seeing their own ultimate destination.

40020448.author: पदार्थः
40020448.content: धर्मात् from righteousness, राज्यम् kingdom, धनम् wealth, सौख्यम् happiness, अधर्मात् from unrighteousness, दुःखम् sorrow, एव only, च and, तस्मात् therefore, धर्मम् righteousness, सुखार्थाय for the sake of happiness, कुर्यात् one should do, पापम् sin, विसर्जयेत् one should abandon.

40020448.author: Translation
40020448.content: From righteousness come kingdom, wealth, and happiness, while from unrighteousness comes only sorrow; therefore, one should practice righteousness for the sake of happiness and abandon sin.

40020449.author: पदार्थः
40020449.content: पापस्य of sin, हि indeed, फलम् the fruit, दुःखम् is sorrow, तत् that, भोक्तव्यम् must be experienced, इह here, आत्मना by oneself; तस्मात् therefore, आत्म self, अपघातार्थम् for the destruction, मूढः a fool, पापम् sin, करिष्यति will commit.

40020449.author: Translation
40020449.content: Indeed, the fruit of sin is sorrow, which one must experience oneself in this world; therefore, only a fool would commit sin for the purpose of self-destruction.

40020450.author: पदार्थः
40020450.content: कस्यचित् of anyone, न not, हि indeed, दुर्बुद्धेः of an evil-minded person, छन्दतः by one's own will, जायते arises, मतिः the intellect; दैवम् destiny, चेष्टयते directs, सर्वम् everything; हतः one who is struck, दैवेन by fate, हन्यते is destroyed; यादृशम् whatever kind of, कुरुते one performs, कर्म action, तादृशम् that kind of, फलम् fruit, अश्नुते one obtains.

40020450.author: Translation
40020450.content: Indeed, the intellect of an evil-minded person does not arise by their own will, for destiny directs everything, and one struck by fate is destroyed, ultimately receiving the fruit corresponding to the actions one performs.

40020451.author: पदार्थः
40020451.content: बुद्धि intellect, रूपम् beauty, फलम् prosperity, पुत्रान् sons, शौर्यम् valor, धीरत्वम् steadfastness, एव indeed, च and, प्राप्नुवन्ति obtain, नराः men, लोके in the world, निर्जितम् acquired, पुण्यकर्मभिः by meritorious deeds.

40020451.author: Translation
40020451.content: Men in this world obtain intellect, beauty, prosperity, sons, valor, and steadfastness, all of which are acquired through meritorious deeds.

40020452.author: पदार्थः
40020452.content: एवम् thus, निरयगामी one who goes to hell, त्वम् you, यस्य whose, ते your, मतिः intellect, ईदृशी is such; न not, त्वाम् to you, समभिभाषिष्ये I will speak; असद्वृत्तेषु among those of bad conduct, एव indeed, निर्णयः is the judgment.

40020452.author: Translation
40020452.content: You are destined for hell, as your intellect is of such a nature; I will not speak to you, for such is the judgment for those of bad conduct.

40020453.author: पदार्थः
40020453.content: एवम् thus, उक्ताः spoken to, ततः then, तेन by him, तस्य his, अमात्याः ministers, समाहताः rebuked, मारीचप्रमुखाः Maricha and others, सर्वे all, विमुखाः with averted faces, विप्रदुद्रुवुः fled in all directions.

40020453.author: Translation
40020453.content: Thus rebuked by him, all his ministers, led by Maricha, turned their faces away and fled in all directions.

40020454.author: पदार्थः
40020454.content: ततः then, तेन by him, दशग्रीवः Dashagriva, यक्षेन्द्रेण by the lord of Yakshas, महात्मना by the great-souled one, गदया with a mace, अभिहतः struck, मूर्ध्नि on the head, न not, च and, स्थानात् from his place, प्रकम्पितः shaken

40020454.author: Translation
40020454.content: Then, the great-souled lord of Yakshas struck Dashagriva on the head with a mace, but Ravana was not shaken from his position.

40020455.author: पदार्थः
40020455.content: ततः then, तौ those two, राम O Rama, निघ्नन्तौ striking, तदा then, अन्योन्यम् each other, महामृधे in the great battle, न not, विह्वलौ distressed, न not, च and, श्रान्तौ weary, बभूवतुः became, अमर्षणौ furious

40020455.author: Translation
40020455.content: O Rama, then those two, striking each other in that great battle, became neither distressed nor weary, but remained furious.

40020456.author: पदार्थः
40020456.content: आग्नेयम् fiery, अस्त्रम् weapon, तस्मै at him, सः he, मुमोच released, धनदः Dhanada, तदा then, राक्षसेन्द्रः the lord of Rakshasas, वारुणेन with the Varuna weapon, तत् that, अस्त्रम् weapon, प्रत्यवारयत् countered

40020456.author: Translation
40020456.content: Then Dhanada released the fiery weapon at him, but the lord of Rakshasas countered that weapon with the Varuna weapon.

40020457.author: पदार्थः
40020457.content: ततः then, मायाम् illusion, प्रविष्टः entered, असौ that, राक्षसीम् demonic, राक्षसेश्वरः the lord of Rakshasas, रूपाणाम् of forms, शतसाहस्रम् a hundred thousand, विनाशाय for destruction, चकार made, च and

40020457.author: Translation
40020457.content: Then, that lord of Rakshasas entered into a demonic illusion and created a hundred thousand forms for destruction.

40020458.author: पदार्थः
40020458.content: व्याघ्रः a tiger, वराहः a boar, जीमूतः a cloud, पर्वतः a mountain, सागरः an ocean, द्रुमः a tree, यक्षः a Yaksha, दैत्यस्वरूपी having the form of a Daitya, च and, सः he, अदृश्यत was seen, दशाननः Dashanana

40020458.author: Translation
40020458.content: Dashanana was then seen in the forms of a tiger, a boar, a cloud, a mountain, an ocean, a tree, a Yaksha, and a Daitya.

40020459.author: पदार्थः
40020459.content: बहूनि many, च and, करोति स्म was doing, दृश्यन्ते are seen, न not, तु indeed, असौ he (Ravana), ततः from that, प्रतिगृह्य having received, ततो then, राम O Rama, महत् great, अस्त्रम् weapon, दशाननः Ravana.

40020459.author: Translation
40020459.content: Ravana, having received a great weapon, was performing many actions, but he himself was not visible.

40020460.author: पदार्थः
40020460.content: जघान struck, मूर्ध्नि on the head, धनदम् Kubera, व्याविद्ध्य having whirled, महतीम् great, गदाम् mace, एवम् thus, सः he (Kubera), तेन by him (Ravana), अभिहतः struck, विह्वलः bewildered, शोणितोक्षितः drenched in blood.

40020460.author: Translation
40020460.content: Having whirled a great mace, Ravana struck Kubera on the head, and thus Kubera, bewildered and drenched in blood, was struck by him.

40020461.author: पदार्थः
40020461.content: कृत्तमूलः with roots cut, इव like, अशोकः an Ashoka tree, निपपात fell down, धनाधिपः the lord of wealth (Kubera).

40020461.author: Translation
40020461.content: The lord of wealth, Kubera, fell down like an Ashoka tree whose roots had been cut.

40020462.author: पदार्थः
40020462.content: ततः then, पद्मादिभिः by Padma and others, तत्र there, निधिभिः by the treasures, सः he (Kubera), तदा then, वृतः surrounded, धनदः Kubera, उच्छ्वासितः revived, तैस्तु by them, वनम् to the forest, आनीय having brought, नन्दनम् Nandana.

40020462.author: Translation
40020462.content: Then, surrounded by the treasures like Padma and others, Kubera was revived by them and brought to the Nandana forest.

40020463.author: पदार्थः
40020463.content: निर्जित्य having conquered, राक्षसेन्द्रः the lord of Rakshasas (Ravana), तम् him, धनदम् Kubera, हृष्टमानसः with a joyful mind, पुष्पकम् Pushpaka, तस्य his, जग्राह took, विमानम् aerial chariot, जयलक्षणम् marked by victory.

40020463.author: Translation
40020463.content: Having conquered Kubera, the lord of Rakshasas, Ravana, with a joyful mind, took his Pushpaka aerial chariot, which was a symbol of victory.

40020464.author: पदार्थः
40020464.content: काञ्चनस्तम्भसंवीतं surrounded by golden pillars, वैडूर्यमणितोरणम् with archways of cat's eye gems, मुक्ताजालप्रतिच्छन्नं covered with nets of pearls, सर्वकामफलद्रुमम् a wish-fulfilling tree.

40020464.author: Translation
40020464.content: The Pushpaka Vimana was adorned with golden pillars, archways made of cat's eye gems, and covered with nets of pearls, resembling a wish-fulfilling tree that grants all desires.

40020465.author: पदार्थः
40020465.content: मनोजवं swift as thought, कामगमं moving at will, कामरूपं changing form at will, विहङ्गमम् a flying vehicle, मणिकाञ्चनसोपानं with stairs of gems and gold, तप्तकाञ्चनवेदिकम् with platforms of refined gold.

40020465.author: Translation
40020465.content: This flying vehicle was swift as thought, could move and change its form at will, and featured stairs made of gems and gold, along with platforms of refined gold.

40020466.author: पदार्थः
40020466.content: देवोपवाह्यम a vehicle for gods, अक्षय्यं imperishable, सदादृष्टिमनःसुखम् always pleasing to sight and mind, बह्वाश्चर्यं full of many wonders, भक्तिचित्रं wonderfully adorned, ब्रह्मणा by Brahma, परिनिर्मितम् perfectly created.

40020466.author: Translation
40020466.content: This imperishable vehicle, created perfectly by Brahma, was fit for gods, always pleasing to the eyes and mind, and wonderfully adorned with many marvels.

40020467.author: पदार्थः
40020467.content: निर्मितं created, सर्वकामैस्तु indeed with all desired comforts, मनोहरम captivating the mind, अनुत्तमम् unsurpassed, न तु शीतं neither cold, न चोष्णं nor hot, च and, सर्वर्तुसुखदं giving comfort in all seasons, शुभम् auspicious.

40020467.author: Translation
40020467.content: It was an unsurpassed, mind-captivating creation, endowed with all desired comforts, neither cold nor hot, providing pleasantness in all seasons, and truly auspicious.

40020468.author: पदार्थः
40020468.content: स He, तं that, राजा king (Ravana), समारुह्य having ascended, कामगं moving at will, वीर्यनिर्जितम् conquered by his prowess, जितं conquered, त्रिभुवनं the three worlds, मेने he thought, दर्पोत्सेकात् due to excessive pride, सुदुर्मतिः the very foolish one.

40020468.author: Translation
40020468.content: Having ascended that wish-fulfilling vehicle, which he had conquered by his prowess, the very foolish King Ravana, swollen with excessive pride, believed he had conquered the three worlds.

40020469.author: पदार्थः
40020469.content: जित्वा having conquered, वैश्रवणं Vaiśravaṇa (Kubera), देवं the god, कैलासात् from Kailasa, समवातरत् descended.

40020469.author: Translation
40020469.content: Having conquered the god Vaiśravaṇa (Kubera), he descended from Mount Kailasa.

40020470.author: पदार्थः
40020470.content: स्वतेजसा by his own prowess, विपुलम् great, अवाप्य having obtained, तं that, जयं victory, प्रतापवान् the mighty one, विमलकिरीटहारवान् adorned with a spotless crown and necklace, रराज shone, वै indeed, परमविमानम् the excellent aerial chariot, आस्थितः having mounted, निशाचरः the night-wanderer (Rakshasa), सदसि in an assembly, गतः present, यथा like, अनलः fire.

40020470.author: Translation
40020470.content: Having achieved that great victory by his own prowess, the mighty Rakshasa, adorned with a spotless crown and necklace, shone brightly while seated in the excellent aerial chariot, like fire present in an assembly. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीये आदिकाव्ये श्रीमदुत्तरकाण्डे पञ्चदशः सर्गः ।। 15 ।। Thus ends the fifteenth sarga of Uttara Kanda of the holy Ramayana the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.
